data.name: Ujjal
data.gender_notes: Ujjal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ujjal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujjval', which means 'flame' or 'light'. In Hindu mythology, the sun is often depicted as a blazing flame, bringing light and warmth to the world. The name Ujjal is also associated with vitality, radiance, and illumination. The name Ujjal carries the meaning “Flame, Light, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ujjal usually hope their child will grow to embody flame, light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ujjal represents the divine flame within each individual, symbolizing the inner light that guides us through life. It also represents the power of the sun, which is a source of energy, warmth, and life.
data.etymology: Ujjal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flame, Light, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ujjal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
